name: BMW M5 CS
description: The BMW M5 CS is the most powerful BMW ever built, combining luxury and extreme performance. Lightweight design and precision handling define this masterpiece.

reviews.name: Oleh S.
reviews.text: A beast in a suit. Comfort and speed in perfect harmony!

reviews.name: Kateryna L.
reviews.text: The acceleration is unreal. Feels like a race car wrapped in luxury.

name: BMW X7 M60i
description: The BMW X7 M60i is the flagship SUV that blends elegance, space, and M performance. The perfect mix of power, comfort, and innovation.

reviews.name: Andrii P.
reviews.text: Massive presence, effortless power. The best family luxury SUV.

reviews.name: Iryna S.
reviews.text: Incredible comfort and attention to detail. Drives like a dream.

name: BMW 7 Series 760i xDrive
description: The BMW 7 Series 760i xDrive delivers first-class luxury with a commanding V8 engine and an interior designed for ultimate comfort and innovation.

reviews.name: Taras B.
reviews.text: The ultimate executive car. Smooth, silent, and powerful.

reviews.name: Olha H.
reviews.text: Every detail screams luxury. Perfect for long drives.

name: BMW 8 Series M850i xDrive
description: The BMW 8 Series M850i xDrive combines elegant design with breathtaking performance, offering a grand touring experience like no other.

reviews.name: Mykhailo N.
reviews.text: Incredible balance of sport and luxury. Feels special every time.

reviews.name: Alina R.
reviews.text: A true head-turner — fast, elegant, and full of tech.

name: BMW XM Label Red
description: The BMW XM Label Red is a bold plug-in hybrid that delivers exceptional power, luxury, and exclusivity. A statement of performance and prestige.

reviews.name: Denys T.
reviews.text: Powerful, aggressive, and unique. The red accents are stunning!

reviews.name: Viktoriia M.
reviews.text: It’s a luxury SUV that feels like a supercar. Absolutely love it!

name: BMW Alpina B7
description: The BMW Alpina B7 blends handcrafted luxury with breathtaking speed. One of the fastest and most refined sedans in the world.

reviews.name: Yurii V.
reviews.text: Unmatched ride comfort and speed. The perfect business sedan.

name: BMW X6 M Competition
description: The BMW X6 M Competition redefines the SUV coupe with its dynamic design and heart-pounding M performance.

reviews.name: Roman D.
reviews.text: Feels like a sports car but higher. Incredible handling!

reviews.name: Diana Z.
reviews.text: Beautiful design and crazy fast. Worth every cent.
